items.label: Would most like a print book

notes: Heavy readers are a minority, but a slowly growing one. Adults who read ten or more print books a year were 10.2% in 2017 and 13.5% in 2025, up 3.3 points in eight years. We could not verify 2018 or 2022, so those years are blank, not filled in. Another pair of numbers says more: 45.9% say their preferred way to read is to pick up a print book, yet only 30.3% are satisfied with their own reading. There is a gap between wanting to read and getting to read, and that gap is where a reading magazine belongs. Since 2024 the answers to the preference question add up to more than 100%, so several answers may be allowed, and we do not draw it as a pie.
